newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech EuroTel says GSM clients exceed network plan.
newsitem.headline: Czech EuroTel says GSM clients exceed network plan.

text.p: Czech mobile telephone operator EuroTel sro said on Thursday its client base had grown to about 190,000 users in 1996, with 100,000 customers on its digital GSM network since it was launched last July.

Managing Director Mac Allman told a news conference that EuroTel's GSM client growth had exceeded expectations, but had also put a strain on the service, drawing complaints about bottlenecks and disconnections.
"We built (GSM) systems to support 85,000 to 90,000 customers (in 1996), so we did a terrible job of forecasting the size of the total market," Allman said.
"We are in the process now of remedying that situation. We have added a great number of cell sites, including some mini-cell sites where there are some real traffic problems."
Allman added that EuroTel was having some problems cutting through Czech bureaucracy to get permission for stationing new transmitters to expand the network.
But he said that the company should easily meet the rollout targets set in its licence agreement with the government.
EuroTel is a joint-venture of Czech fixed-line monopoly SPT Telecom a.s. along with U.S. firms Bell Atlantic International and U.S. West Media Group.
Allman said that full 1996 financial results for EuroTel would not be released until an audit is completed.

EuroTel said in a statement its GSM network now covered 76 percent of the population and 65 percent of Czech territory, while coverage of its NMT analogue network, launched earlier this decade, was 96 percent and 92 percent respectively.

Earlier, EuroTel's sole competitor RadioMobil a.s., a Czech joint venture with a consortium led by Deutsche Telekom AG, said its "Paegas" GSM network launched last September had 40,000 customers and coverage of roughly 40 percent of the Czech population of 10.4 million.
Further data from RadioMobil, majority owned by Czech transmission company Ceska Radiokomunikace a.s., was not yet available.
